info.title: MAQDAR API
info.description:
Bulk upserts and lists of MAQDAR master data and demand history, per organization.
Read saved purchase handoffs and batches with explicit organization-wide purchase_handoffs:read permission. These are planning evidence, not external orders.

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer maqdar_sk_…`; an owner or admin creates keys in Settings. Keys are scoped (master_data:read, master_data:write, transactions:read, transactions:write, purchase_handoffs:read, purchase_handoffs:acknowledge), expire, and stop working when their creator is no longer an owner or admin.

Upserts are `POST /{resource}:upsert` with `{"records": [...]}`: all or nothing, by natural key, with the same field rules as the import wizard. Every record carries the same fields; a field left out keeps its stored value; null or "" clears a nullable field. Decimals are accepted as JSON numbers or strings and always returned as canonical strings. Load parents before children (x-maqdar-load-order).

Errors are RFC 9457 problems (`application/problem+json`) with a stable `code` and a `request_id`. Honour `Retry-After` on 409, 429 and 503.

Documentation: https://github.com/aqoza/MAQDAR/blob/main/docs/api.md

x-maqdar-scopes.master_data:read: List master data (calendars, locations, brands, items, suppliers, …).
x-maqdar-scopes.transactions:read: List demand history, stock snapshots, open orders and receipts.
x-maqdar-scopes.transactions:write: Upsert demand history, stock snapshots, open orders and receipts.
x-maqdar-scopes.purchase_handoffs:read: Read saved purchase handoffs and batches across the organization; no order execution.
x-maqdar-scopes.purchase_handoffs:acknowledge: Append external receipt or rejection reports for saved purchase handoffs and batches across the organization; no order execution.

get.description:
Organization-wide access requires purchase_handoffs:read. Includes current and historical records. GET and HEAD never create orders, reserve quantities, acknowledge transmission or change evidence. Responses are private and no-store.

Newest created_at first, then UUID ascending. Pass next_cursor unchanged with the same created_since until null; limit may change. created_since is inclusive and creation-based, not a selection-change feed. as_of excludes later creation times but does not provide transaction snapshot isolation: late commits or deletions can affect traversal. Reconcile with overlapping creation windows and deduplicate by ID; re-read known IDs for current selection. Unknown, repeated or empty parameters return 400.

parameters.name: created_since
parameters.description: Inclusive RFC 3339 timestamp with offset. Keep unchanged while following a cursor.

200.description: A page of saved summaries and live selection.

Organization-wide access requires purchase_handoffs:read. Includes current and historical records. GET and HEAD never create orders, reserve quantities, acknowledge transmission or change evidence. Responses are private and no-store.

data.payload contains the original saved JSON values (including exact decimal strings), equivalent to the application JSON download. Organization-wide scoped API-key access. Events are append-only caller reports and do not verify external acceptance, create orders, change inbound or approvals, or alter saved evidence. Historical packages are eligible. Batch reports never propagate to individual handoffs or overlapping batches. recorded_at is server recording time; no global external delivery state is inferred.

Newest recorded_at then UUID ascending. The cursor binds organization, resource and parent. Its creation-time upper bound is not a transactional snapshot; concurrent commits/deletions may affect traversal. Reconcile with overlap and deduplicate by event ID. Only limit and cursor are accepted.

GET/HEAD require purchase_handoffs:read; POST requires purchase_handoffs:acknowledge. Existing events have no PUT/PATCH/DELETE routes. All responses are no-store. Browser sessions are not API credentials.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Records per page. Out of range is a 400, not clamped.

TransactionLimit.name: limit
TransactionLimit.description: Records per page. Out of range is a 400, not clamped.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page, unchanged, with the same other parameters.

UpdatedSince.name: updated_since
UpdatedSince.description: Only records changed at or after this instant (RFC 3339 with an offset).

To.name: to
To.description: Last demand date (inclusive); at most 366 days in all.

X-Request-Id.description: The request id; quote it to support.

NotFound.description: No record with this ID in the key organization.

UpsertBadRequest.description: The body is not valid JSON (invalid_json), or the URL has a query string (invalid_parameter).

Conflict.description: Another write holds the organization, or the data changed (acknowledgement_conflict, import_in_progress, busy, write_conflict).

is_active.description: false for calendars no longer used.

updated_at.description: Last change (UTC, microseconds). Ignored when the record is sent back.
